-- Doublon p-cymène
SELECT id, name, cas_number, smiles, family, coconut_id FROM molecules WHERE name LIKE '%cym%' OR name LIKE '%Cym%' ORDER BY name;

-- État enrichissement LOTUS
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN coconut_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enrichies,
  SUM(CASE WHEN coconut_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as non_enrichies,
  COUNT(*) as total
FROM molecules;

-- Molécules marquées "introuvable" dans LOTUS
SELECT id, name, coconut_id FROM molecules WHERE coconut_id = 'NOT_FOUND' OR coconut_id = 'not_found' LIMIT 20;
